# Checks on ordinary photos

Someone who never saw the unit's activity answered the questions below about each of 120 photos: all photos of the 12 photo classes on which the unit is most active on average (sports car, beach wagon, tow truck, pickup, minibus, trailer truck, airliner, minivan, convertible, ambulance, grille, police van). For each answer: the number of photos given it, and d, how much more (positive) or less (negative) active the unit is on them than on the other photos, after removing the differences between classes, in standard deviations. Each question also has a separation score, the share of the unit's within-class variation that its answers account for. Each number comes with this unit's percentile among all 528 units of its layer, computed on the same photos and answers (above 95 or below 5 is unusual for this layer).

separation: percentile 54
